=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  WHY: The local state advances, but the GitHub-comment-persisted state stays stale and the next poll cycle can reread old state and repeat work.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:265-267 (cmd_extract completeness check) | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The expression `"".join(slot[p] for p in range(1, total + 1))` allocates the full stitched base64 string before SHA256 manifest verification.
  WHY: A forged or corrupted chain can force a large allocation before the integrity check rejects it, increasing memory pressure.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2703-2739 (inline Python for capture_intent_fingerprints_for_merged_subissue substring filter) | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The substring-overlap filter uses `stripped in a` on raw diff text to drop removed-line fingerprints.
  WHY: A legitimate `must_not_contain` fingerprint can be dropped when a different same-file added line happens to contain the removed text as a substring.
